// Swift old (_T) mangling corpus.
// Format: symbol ---> expected output
// Lines starting with // are comments. Blank lines are ignored.
// Oracle: /usr/lib/swift/bin/swift-demangle

// Builtin types (from Apple manglings.txt)
_TtBf32_ ---> Builtin.FPIEEE32
_TtBf64_ ---> Builtin.FPIEEE64
_TtBf80_ ---> Builtin.FPIEEE80
_TtBi32_ ---> Builtin.Int32
_TtBw ---> Builtin.Word
_TtBO ---> Builtin.UnknownObject
_TtBo ---> Builtin.NativeObject
_TtBp ---> Builtin.RawPointer
_TtBt ---> Builtin.SILToken
_TtBv4Bi8_ ---> Builtin.Vec4xInt8
_TtBv4Bf16_ ---> Builtin.Vec4xFPIEEE16
_TtBv4Bp ---> Builtin.Vec4xRawPointer

// Stdlib shorthands
_TtSa ---> Swift.Array
_TtSb ---> Swift.Bool
_TtSc ---> Swift.UnicodeScalar
_TtSd ---> Swift.Double
_TtSf ---> Swift.Float
_TtSi ---> Swift.Int
_TtSq ---> Swift.Optional
_TtSS ---> Swift.String
_TtSu ---> Swift.UInt
_TtSV ---> Swift.UnsafeRawPointer
_TtSv ---> Swift.UnsafeMutableRawPointer
_TtSP ---> Swift.UnsafePointer
_TtSp ---> Swift.UnsafeMutablePointer
_TtSR ---> Swift.UnsafeBufferPointer
_TtSr ---> Swift.UnsafeMutableBufferPointer
_TtSQ ---> Swift.ImplicitlyUnwrappedOptional

// Nominal types (struct, class, enum)
_TtCSo8NSObject ---> __C.NSObject
_TtO6Monads6Either ---> Monads.Either
_TtVs7CString ---> Swift.CString
_TtC6Monads6Either ---> Monads.Either

// Bound generic types
_TtGSPSi_ ---> Swift.UnsafePointer<Swift.Int>
_TtGSpSi_ ---> Swift.UnsafeMutablePointer<Swift.Int>
_TtGSaSS_ ---> [Swift.String]
_TtGSqSS_ ---> Swift.String?
_TtGVs10DictionarySSSi_ ---> [Swift.String : Swift.Int]

// Protocol types
_TtP_ ---> Any
_TtP3foo3bar_ ---> foo.bar
_TtP3foo3barS_3bas_ ---> foo.bar & foo.bas

// Function types
_TtbSiSu ---> @convention(block) (Swift.Int) -> Swift.UInt
_TtcSiSu ---> @convention(c) (Swift.Int) -> Swift.UInt
_TtFSiSu ---> (Swift.Int) -> Swift.UInt
_TtKSiSu ---> @autoclosure (Swift.Int) -> Swift.UInt
_TtFSiFScSu ---> (Swift.Int) -> (Swift.UnicodeScalar) -> Swift.UInt
_TtbTSiSc_Su ---> @convention(block) (Swift.Int, Swift.UnicodeScalar) -> Swift.UInt
_TtcTSiSc_Su ---> @convention(c) (Swift.Int, Swift.UnicodeScalar) -> Swift.UInt

// Inout
_TtRSi ---> inout Swift.Int

// Tuple types
_TtTSiSu_ ---> (Swift.Int, Swift.UInt)
_TttSiSu_ ---> (Swift.Int, Swift.UInt...)
_TtT3fooSi3barSu_ ---> (foo: Swift.Int, bar: Swift.UInt)

// Metatype
_TtMSi ---> Swift.Int.Type

// Variable entities
_Tv3foo3barSi ---> foo.bar : Swift.Int

// Function entities with accessors
_TF3fooau3barSi ---> foo.bar.unsafeMutableAddressor : Swift.Int
_TF3foolu3barSi ---> foo.bar.unsafeAddressor : Swift.Int
_TF3foog3barSi ---> foo.bar.getter : Swift.Int
_TF3foos3barSi ---> foo.bar.setter : Swift.Int

// W2: generic-param shorthands (archetype types)
// 'x' = first generic param A (depth=0, index=0)
_TtFxSi ---> (A) -> Swift.Int
_TtFxx ---> (A) -> A
_TtMx ---> A.Type
_TtRx ---> inout A
// 'q_' = second generic param B (depth=0, index=1)
_TtFq_Si ---> (B) -> Swift.Int
_TtFq_x ---> (B) -> A
_TtFxq_ ---> (A) -> B
// 'qN_' = generic param N+2 at depth 0
_TtFq0_Si ---> (C) -> Swift.Int
_TtFq1_Si ---> (D) -> Swift.Int
// 'qd__' = generic param A at depth 1 (outer generic context)
_TtFqd__Si ---> (A1) -> Swift.Int
_TtFqd0__Si ---> (A2) -> Swift.Int
_TtFqd_0_Si ---> (B1) -> Swift.Int

// W2: bound generic types with generic-param type args
_TtGSax_ ---> [A]
_TtGSqx_ ---> A?
_TtGSPx_ ---> Swift.UnsafePointer<A>
_TtGSpx_ ---> Swift.UnsafeMutablePointer<A>
_TtGSRx_ ---> Swift.UnsafeBufferPointer<A>
_TtGSrx_ ---> Swift.UnsafeMutableBufferPointer<A>
_TtGSqq__ ---> B?
_TtGSaq__ ---> [B]
_TtGVs10DictionaryxSi_ ---> [A : Swift.Int]
_TtGVs10DictionarySix_ ---> [Swift.Int : A]
_TtGVs10DictionaryxSS_ ---> [A : Swift.String]
_TtGC3foo4PairxSi_ ---> foo.Pair<A, Swift.Int>
_TtGC3foo3BarxSi_ ---> foo.Bar<A, Swift.Int>
_TtGO3foo3BazxSi_ ---> foo.Baz<A, Swift.Int>
_TtGV3foo3Quxxx_ ---> foo.Qux<A, A>
_TtGV3foo3Quxxq__ ---> foo.Qux<A, B>
// function types with generic-param args
_TtFxGSax_ ---> (A) -> [A]
_TtFGSax_x ---> ([A]) -> A
// nested bound generic (Node<[A]>)
_TtGC3foo4NodeGSax__ ---> foo.Node<[A]>
